Arabic text: بِسْمِ اللَّـهِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ خَلَقْتَنِيْ سَوِيًّا
Translation: O Allah, You created me in perfect form

Arabic text: وَ رَبَّيْتَنِيْ صَغِيرًا، وَ رَزَقْتَنِيْ مَكْفِيًّا
Translation: And raised me when I was small, and provided for me sufficiently

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّيْ وَجَدْتُ فِيمَا أَنْزَلْتَ مِنْ كِتَابِكَ
Translation: O Allah, I found in what You revealed in Your Book

Arabic text: وَ بَشَّرْتَ بِهِ عِبَادَكَ
Translation: And with which You gave good news to Your servants

Arabic text: يَا عِبَادِيَ الَّذِيْنَ أَسْرَفُوْا عَلَى أَنْفُسِهِمْ
Translation: "O My servants who have transgressed against themselves

Arabic text: لَا تَقْنَطُوْا مِنْ رَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ، إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعًا
Translation: Do not despair of the mercy of Allah. Indeed, Allah forgives all sins"

Arabic text: وَ قَدْ تَقَدَّمَ مِنِّيْ مَا قَدْ عَلِمْتَ
Translation: And there has proceeded from me what You know

Arabic text: وَ مَا أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنِّي
Translation: And what You know better than I do

Arabic text: فَيَا سَوْأَتَا مِمَّا أَحْصَاهُ عَلَيَّ كِتَابُكَ
Translation: Oh, how grievous is what Your Book has enumerated against me

Arabic text: فَلَوْ لَا الْمَوَاقِفُ الَّتِيْ أُؤَمِّلُ مِنْ عَفْوِكَ
Translation: Were it not for the situations in which I hope for Your pardon

Arabic text: اَلَّذِيْ شَمِلَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ لَأَلْقَيْتُ بِيَدِي
Translation: Which encompasses everything, I would have given up

Arabic text: وَ لَوْ أَنَّ أَحَدًا اسْتَطَاعَ الْهَرَبَ
Translation: And if anyone could escape

Arabic text: مِنْ رَبِّهِ لَكُنْتُ أَنَا أَحَقَّ بِالْهَرَبِ
Translation: From his Lord, I would be most deserving of escape

Arabic text: وَ أَنْتَ لَا تَخْفَى عَلَيْكَ خَافِيَةٌ فِيْ الْأَرْضِ
Translation: But nothing is hidden from You on earth

Arabic text: وَ لَا فِيْ السَّمَاءِ إِلَّا أَتَيْتَ بِهَا
Translation: Nor in the heavens except that You bring it forth

Arabic text: وَ كَفَى بِكَ جَازِيًا، وَ كَفَى بِكَ حَسِيبًا
Translation: You are sufficient as a recompenser, and sufficient as a reckoner

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ طَالِبِيْ إِنْ أَنَا هَرَبْتُ
Translation: O Allah, You will seek me if I flee

Arabic text: وَ مُدْرِكِيْ إِنْ أَنَا فَرَرْتُ
Translation: And You will catch me if I run away

Arabic text: فَهَا أَنَا ذَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ خَاضِعٌ ذَلِيلٌ رَاغِمٌ
Translation: So here I am before You, submissive, humble, and lowly

Arabic text: إِنْ تُعَذِّبْنِيْ فَإِنِّيْ لِذَلِكَ أَهْلٌ
Translation: If You punish me, then I am deserving of that

Arabic text: وَ هُوَ يَا رَبِّ مِنْكَ عَدْلٌ
Translation: And that, O my Lord, would be just from You

Arabic text: وَ إِنْ تَعْفُ عَنِّيْ فَقَدِيمًا شَمَلَنِيْ عَفْوُكَ
Translation: And if You pardon me, then Your pardon has long encompassed me

Arabic text: وَ أَلْبَسْتَنِيْ عَافِيَتَكَ
Translation: And You have clothed me in Your protection

Arabic text: فَأَسْأَلُكَ اللَّهُمَّ بِالْمَخْزُوْنِ مِنْ أَسْمَائِكَ
Translation: So I ask You, O Allah, by the hidden treasures of Your names

Arabic text: وَ بِمَا وَارَتْهُ الْحُجُبُ مِنْ بَهَائِكَ
Translation: And by what the veils have concealed of Your splendor

Arabic text: إِلَّا رَحِمْتَ هَذِهِ النَّفْسَ الْجَزُوعَةَ
Translation: To have mercy on this anxious soul

Arabic text: وَ هَذِهِ الرِّمَّةَ الْهَلُوعَةَ
Translation: And this fearful body

Arabic text: اَلَّتِيْ لَا تَسْتَطِيعُ حَرَّ شَمْسِكَ
Translation: Which cannot endure the heat of Your sun

Arabic text: فَكَيْفَ تَسْتَطِيعُ حَرَّ نَارِكَ
Translation: So how can it endure the heat of Your Fire?

Arabic text: وَ الَّتِيْ لَا تَسْتَطِيعُ صَوْتَ رَعْدِكَ
Translation: And which cannot bear the sound of Your thunder

Arabic text: فَكَيْفَ تَسْتَطِيعُ صَوْتَ غَضَبِكَ
Translation: So how can it bear the sound of Your wrath?

Arabic text: فَارْحَمْنِيْ اللَّهُمَّ فَإِنِّيْ امْرُؤٌ حَقِيرٌ، وَ خَطَرِيْ يَسِيرٌ
Translation: Have mercy on me, O Allah, for I am an insignificant person, and my worth is small

Arabic text: وَ لَيْسَ عَذَابِيْ مِمَّا يَزِيدُ فِيْ مُلْكِكَ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ
Translation: And my punishment would not add even an atom's weight to Your kingdom

Arabic text: وَ لَوْ أَنَّ عَذَابِيْ مِمَّا يَزِيدُ فِيْ مُلْكِكَ
Translation: And if my punishment would increase Your kingdom

Arabic text: لَسَأَلْتُكَ الصَّبْرَ عَلَيْهِ
Translation: I would ask You for patience to bear it

Arabic text: وَ أَحْبَبْتُ أَنْ يَكُونَ ذٰلِكَ لَكَ
Translation: And I would love for that to be Yours

Arabic text: وَ لَكِنْ سُلْطَانُكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَعْظَمُ
Translation: But Your authority, O Allah, is greater

Arabic text: وَ مُلْكُكَ أَدْوَمُ مِنْ أَنْ تَزِيدَ فِيهِ طَاعَةُ الْمُطِيعِينَ
Translation: And Your kingdom is more everlasting than to be increased by the obedience of the obedient

Arabic text: أَوْ تَنْقُصَ مِنْهُ مَعْصِيَةُ الْمُذْنِبِينَ
Translation: Or decreased by the disobedience of the sinners

Arabic text: فَارْحَمْنِيْ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ
Translation: So have mercy on me, O Most Merciful of those who show mercy

Arabic text: وَ تَجَاوَزْ عَنِّيْ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَ الْإِكْرَامِ
Translation: And overlook my sins, O Possessor of Majesty and Honor

Arabic text: وَ تُبْ عَلَيَّ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ
Translation: And accept my repentance, for You are the Acceptor of Repentance, the Most Merciful
